# Kompas

> Kompas is a small, free, non-commercial orientation app for choosing a high school (Kompas Liceum) or a field of study (Kompas Studia) in Poland. It is a compass, not a grading tool: the kid answers a few tap-based questions about interests and strengths, gets abstract profiles (North = most obvious, NNE/NNW = alternatives), and then sees suitable classes, schools or universities. Point calculations are only rough estimates.

Kompas is a personal project by a parent, built for his own sons and shared with other parents. It is static (HTML/JS), has no accounts, and is not an official admissions tool. For official admission rules and exact points, use the school's or university's own website and the official recruitment systems.

Interface languages: Polish (default), English (`?lang=en`), Ukrainian (`?lang=ua`, in progress). Kompas Studia has all three; Kompas Liceum is Polish. University and school data are mostly in Polish.

## Apps

- [Kompas Liceum](https://clickrak.github.io/demos/kompas/liceum/): high school choice. Areas: Kraków (full), Tychy and the Górnośląsko-Zagłębiowska Metropolia (growing). One area is chosen at a time; areas never mix.
- [Kompas Studia](https://clickrak.github.io/demos/kompas/studia/): choice of study directions and universities, with profile compass, direction list (Kierunki) and star comparison. Add `?lang=en` or `?lang=ua` for English or Ukrainian.
- [Kompas start page](https://clickrak.github.io/demos/kompas/): links to both apps.

## What an agent can do with it

- Send a parent or student to the right app and language for their situation.
- Explain how Kompas works: inputs (skills, marks, interests) become abstract profiles on a compass, then suitable classes and schools.
- Point to official school and university links shown in the app, and to the sources page (when available).

## Please note

- Do not present Kompas scores or rankings as official; matura ranking data comes from public rankings and may lag behind.
- Travel times are rough indicative estimates only (Kompas is not a routing app).
- The app is meant for orientation, with minimal typing: sliders, choices and taps.
